errors.quote: Each line is, for all segments together, one cyclic shift (sign $\varepsilon$, tested parity $b$) $$y\leftarrow y+\varepsilon\sum_{i=0}^{f-2}2^{j_i}[x_{j_i}=1][z_{j_i}=b]\pmod{2^L}$$
errors.problem: Only four of the eight lines update y. Lines (2),(4),(5),(7) update z and test parities of y, and the paper says 'For a line updating z, interchange y and z in this formula'.

errors.quote: Since $T_0,S_0$ are bijections agreeing off $\mathcal B$, $T_0S_0^{-1}$ fixes $\mathcal B^c$ and permutes $\mathcal B$.
errors.problem: The stated premise is not enough: two bijections agreeing off B only give that T_0S_0^{-1} fixes S_0(B^c). The paper also uses that T_0 preserves the guard values and hence B, so S_0(B^c)=T_0(B^c)=B^c.

p is not an address-length parameter. In the paper it is the precision parameter (p=6ceil(log2 n), coefficients on the grid 2^{-p}Z[i]) and indexes the asymptotic family. A_rect=O(p) is a hypothesis about it, not its definition.
